sub_service: General civic complaints to Faridabad Municipal Corporation
problem_type: General civic issues (waste, water, roads, streetlights, sewer) via MCF's general contact channel
description: Faridabad's real Solid Waste (Management & Handling) Bye-laws 2019 were fetched and fully read this pass (via the Read-tool-on-saved-PDF workaround, after direct extraction returned only garbled image data). The bye-laws themselves are entirely a regulatory document -- generator obligations, segregation rules, and a fines schedule -- with no citizen-facing complaint-resolution SLA anywhere in the 25-page document. The district portal (faridabad.nic.in) confirms a real general contact number, but no category-specific SLA.
procedure: Contact the MCF Head Office directly by phone, or via the MCF Citizen App / MCF 311.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND -- only a general contact number was confirmed on the fetched page. The Solid Waste Bye-laws 2019 document was directly read in full and confirmed to contain no complaint-SLA content (it is a citizen-obligations/fines-schedule document, not a service charter).
contact_information: Phone: 0129-2416464. Head Office: B.K. Chowk, Faridabad.
escalation_procedure: NOT FOUND IN OFFICIAL SOURCE on the fetched pages -- WebSearch-only summaries mention escalation to the CM Window Haryana grievance system, but this was not independently confirmed via a direct fetch of an official page, so not included here.
